title: Generative AI for Professionals: Beginner to Pro

01genai-syllabus-2026-complete-roadmap-f.title: 01. GenAI Syllabus 2026: Complete Roadmap from LLM Foundations to Production Deployment
01genai-syllabus-2026-complete-roadmap-f.description: A structured 8-month roadmap for becoming a GenAI engineer. It runs from core prerequisites (Python, SQL, FastAPI, Docker, cloud) through 18 modules: transformer foundations, modern LLMs and SLMs, LLM APIs, training from scratch, fine-tuning (LoRA, QLoRA, RLHF, DPO), self-hosting, prompt and context engineering, RAG and multimodal RAG, agentic AI and multi-agent systems, evaluation, guardrails, MCP, no-code tools, cloud AI services (AWS, Azure, GCP), and deployment strategies. It ends with a full end-to-end project, a document portal with HLD/LLD, an advanced RAG design and a plan for scaling to 1M users per hour. ML and DL are optional, so it suits backend and full-stack developers as well as freshers ready for hands-on work.
